review.recipe: 300 ml functional metal julep cup, natural frost, pounded crushed ice, small mint bouquet and short straw; no extra garnish or visible liquid claim. v1 oversized ice improved in v2; residual irregular chips plausible.
review.personality: Folded cream letters with blank reverse sides and open envelope echo three pages written to the person who listens; angled pulled-up burgundy chair invites the second question. Papers survive partially in portrait; envelope is peripheral.
review.world: Dark worn walnut surface and warm reading room, neutral brown-black shadows. Metal is limited to correct serving cup, straw and lamp hardware. Left copy field quiet.
